name: loom-approvals
description: loom's approvals piece: a body that hits a permission wall asks, the owner allows it once on loom's page, and the approval is spent by exactly the action it names; standing rules say which merges need asking at all

loom.name: approvals
loom.label: Approvals
loom.description: Single-use approvals, and standing rules for merging: a body asks for one action, the owner allows or denies it on loom's Home, and it's spent once by exactly that action.

settings.name: APPROVALS_DIR
settings.label: Where approvals are kept
settings.hint: a directory; approvals.json and its audit log live there

settings.name: APPROVALS_LOCAL_AGENT
settings.label: The agent a request from this machine is from
settings.hint: an agent's id; a request made on loom's machine itself (not from a house) is filed as this agent's

settings.name: APPROVALS_KINDS
settings.label: Words for kinds of approval
settings.hint: JSON, like {"github-write": "A GitHub write"}; a kind not named is shown as its own words

settings.name: APPROVALS_SEED_RULES
settings.label: Standing rules to start with
settings.hint: JSON, like [{"kind": "merge", "scope": "github:acme/*", "tier": "do"}]; written once, when there are no rules yet

settings.name: APPROVALS_PRINCIPAL
settings.label: How to check on whose behalf a body acts
settings.hint: the runtime's command; `--verify` checks a statement

settings.name: APPROVALS_LOCAL_PRINCIPAL
settings.label: Who a call on loom's machine acts for
settings.hint: owner (the default) or unknown; a body in a conversation is always its conversation's

settings.name: APPROVALS_PROJECTS
settings.label: How to list projects
settings.hint: the command that prints project cards as JSON, for project rules
